geometry.name: Compact square — revised
geometry.notes: Wardrobe added; cistern against right perimeter, bowl faces left into the bathroom. Square option retained, not the default cabin shape.

geometry.name: Rectangular standard
geometry.notes: 6 × 9 m rectangular cabin; wardrobes and bathroom occupy perimeter walls. Default direction for new standard accommodation, not a stretched square image.

geometry.name: Paired junior-officer cabins

bathroom.privacy: Two private sliding doors; lock both while occupied. Each cabin has its own corridor entrance.

geometry.notes: Two 7.5 × 6 m private rooms at opposite ends of a shared 3 × 6 m central bathroom. Both rooms have wardrobes, desks, beds and independent corridor entrances; no route through a bedroom is required.

geometry.name: Officer suite — rectangular
geometry.notes: Long rectangular suite with dining, living and work areas. The last bedroom is the master, with a private walk-in closet accessed only from that room. All bedrooms and the shared head retain passage entrances; other occupants never cross the master to reach the head.
